d:
Shhhh. dusri manzil jitni oonchaee se koee ghat lagakar baitha hai. ye tenduaa hai, jo apne shikar ki khatir apni jan jokhim men dal deta hai.
Dekhie ek tenduaa shikar ke lie kis had tak ja sakta hai? bharat men soni BBC Earth par 'Planet Earth III' aur aise hi dilchasp sho dekhen.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
